item.title: [Training Data] Anthropic's Katelyn Lesse & Angela Jiang: Building an Ecosystem, not a Walled Garden
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:31 The last layer of abstraction on top of this is probably the coordination layer. So you have knowledge, and you have execution, and you have coordination. And at the coordination layer, we're beginning to think of these things called, like, strategies where, basically, it's almost like a meta harness.
